root_cause: The exclusive checkbox for 'No symptoms' has a data-checkbox-exclusive attribute with an empty string value, which the checkboxes component does not treat as a boolean true, preventing it from clearing other checkboxes in the group.
repair_strategy: Change the attribute to a boolean presence (remove the value) so that the component recognizes it as exclusive.

edits.before: <input class="nhsuk-checkboxes__input" id="symptoms-none" name="symptoms[none]" type="checkbox" value="yes" data-checkbox-exclusive="" data-checkbox-exclusive-group="symptoms">
edits.after: <input class="nhsuk-checkboxes__input" id="symptoms-none" name="symptoms[none]" type="checkbox" value="yes" data-checkbox-exclusive data-checkbox-exclusive-group="symptoms">

expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can now clear symptom selections by activating the exclusive 'No symptoms' checkbox, meeting WCAG 2.1.1, 2.4.3, and 4.1.2.
functional_risks: If the component implementation relies on the attribute value being present, removing the value could cause it to be ignored; however the NHSUK frontend treats the attribute as boolean.
verification_requirements: Verify that selecting 'No symptoms' clears any previously selected symptom checkboxes via keyboard and mouse.
Ensure that selecting a symptom after 'No symptoms' clears the 'No symptoms' checkbox.
Confirm that form data reflects the correct exclusive group state.
